008package release.support;
009
010import java.io.BufferedReader;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.io.InputStreamReader;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014import java.nio.file.Path;
015import java.util.ArrayList;
016import java.util.Arrays;
017import java.util.List;
018
019/**
020 * Utility methods for Git-related operations during the release process.
021 */
022@SuppressWarnings("SameParameterValue")
023public final class GitUtils {
024    private GitUtils() {
025    }
026
027    public static void runCommand(List<String> cmd, Path dir) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
028        System.out.println("🔧 Running: " + String.join(" ", cmd));
029        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);
030        pb.directory(dir.toFile());
031        pb.inheritIO();
032        int exit = pb.start().waitFor();
033        if (exit != 0) {
034            throw new RuntimeException("❌ Command failed: " + String.join(" ", cmd));
035        }
036    }
037
038    /**
039     * Returns the uncommitted changes ({@code git status --porcelain}), one entry per file;
040     * empty when the working tree is clean.
041     */
042    public static List<String> uncommittedChanges(Path repoDir) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
043        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder("git", "status", "--porcelain");
044        pb.directory(repoDir.toFile());
045        Process proc = pb.start();
046        List<String> changes = new ArrayList<>();
047        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(proc.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
048            String line;
049            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
050                if (!line.trim().isEmpty()) {
051                    changes.add(line);
052                }
053            }
054        }
055        if (proc.waitFor() != 0) {
056            throw new RuntimeException("❌ git status failed in " + repoDir);
057        }
058        return changes;
059    }
060
061    /**
062     * Commits the changes to pom.xml files that are already under version control, and nothing
063     * else: a new pom.xml (a module that is not committed yet) and other changed files stay out.
064     */
065    public static void commitTrackedPoms(String message, Path repoDir) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
066        runCommand(Arrays.asList("git", "add", "-u", "--", ":(glob)**/pom.xml"), repoDir);
067        runCommand(Arrays.asList("git", "commit", "-m", message), repoDir);
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Commits the POMs with the release version and tags that commit {@code v<releaseVersion>},
072     * so checking out the tag gives exactly what was released.
073     */
074    public static void commitReleaseAndTag(String releaseVersion, Path repoDir) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
075        commitTrackedPoms("Release " + releaseVersion, repoDir);
076        createLocalTag("v" + releaseVersion, repoDir);
077    }
078
079    public static boolean tagExists(String tagName, Path repoDir) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
080        ProcessBuilder checkPb = new ProcessBuilder("git", "tag", "--list", tagName);
081        checkPb.directory(repoDir.toFile());
082        Process checkProc = checkPb.start();
083        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(checkProc.getInputStream()));
084        boolean exists = false;
085        String line;
086        while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
087            if (line.trim().equals(tagName)) {
088                exists = true;
089                break;
090            }
091        }
092        checkProc.waitFor();
093        return exists;
094    }
095
096    public static void createLocalTag(String tagName, Path repoDir) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
097        System.out.println("🏷️  Creating local tag " + tagName);
098        ProcessBuilder tagPb = new ProcessBuilder("git", "tag", "-a", tagName, "-m", "Release " + tagName);
099        tagPb.directory(repoDir.toFile());
100        tagPb.inheritIO();
101        Process tagProc = tagPb.start();
102        if (tagProc.waitFor() != 0) {
103            throw new RuntimeException("❌ Failed to create local tag " + tagName);
104        }
105        System.out.println("✅ Created local tag " + tagName);
106    }
107
108    public static void pushTag(String tagName, Path repoDir) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
109        System.out.println("📤 Pushing tag " + tagName);
110        ProcessBuilder pushPb = new ProcessBuilder("git", "push", "origin", tagName);
111        pushPb.directory(repoDir.toFile());
112        pushPb.inheritIO();
113        Process pushProc = pushPb.start();
114        if (pushProc.waitFor() != 0) {
115            throw new RuntimeException("❌ Failed to push tag " + tagName);
116        }
117        System.out.println("✅ Successfully pushed tag " + tagName);
118    }
119}
